items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall (quad) was OUT Sunday vs Raiders (not expected per Rap) but is now ready to return and should play Week 9 vs Chiefs.
items.why: Progressed; Rap/GMFB confirm ready after missing 5 straight
items.implication: Hall returns as RB1 but Braelon Allen earned work; possible committee/flex hit both; trade rumors linger pre-deadline
items.opportunity: Monitor full practice; reverse some Allen stash value

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson needs thumb surgery and will be placed on injured reserve after injuring his right (throwing) thumb on the first play vs Bills; coach says potentially season-ending. Huntley also out with turf toe.
items.why: Thumb hit on first snap; surgery confirmed by coach Minter and Schefter/Rapoport/ETR
items.implication: Miss at least 4 games (thru bye); Ravens QB situation collapses to Fagnano; massive downgrade for BAL skill players ROS

items.text: Raiders RB snaps: Mike Washington 38, Ashton Jeanty 25. Jeanty out-carried 25-2; unclear if midweek comments, performance, or both.
items.why: Postgame snap/carry split after midweek noise
items.implication: Jeanty role not secure; committee risk or demotion signal for fantasy
items.opportunity: Washington emerging; monitor Week 9 split closely

items.text: Browns RB snaps: Dylan Sampson 39, Quinshon Judkins 27. Routes Sampson 28, Judkins 10 as CLE fell behind. Judkins a bet on TDs weekly.
items.why: Snap/route disparity in negative game script
items.implication: Judkins more early-down/TD-dependent; limited receiving; volatile weekly

items.text: Steelers RB snaps: Jaylen Warren 34, Rico Dowdle 28. #FreeJaylen
items.implication: Warren preferred; Dowdle viable but secondary; free Warren for more work
items.opportunity: Warren snap lead + efficiency (top missed tackles list)

items.text: Eagles informed Saquon Barkley he is not being traded; Barkley confirmed organization message and wants to help fix issues.
items.why: Org relayed no-trade; Barkley public confirmation
items.implication: Locks Saquon as PHI RB1 ROS; ends speculation

items.text: ACTIVE: DJ Moore, Dalton Kincaid, Jeremiyah Love. OUT: Breece Hall, Carnell Tate, Tyjae Spears.
items.implication: Moore/Kincaid/Love clear; Hall/Tate out confirms; Love clears ankle watch short-term
items.opportunity: Love/Moore startable; reverse Hall beneficiaries short-term
